claim_tested: PI15/p25TI, the protein R3HDML is named after, inhibits trypsin
key_finding: p25TI purified from glioblastoma-conditioned medium 'showed weak inhibitory activity against trypsin in reverse zymography as compared with the other inhibitors'. No Ki or IC50.
context: Human glioblastoma cell conditioned medium, reverse zymography
confidence_and_limitations: Low. Semi-quantitative gel assay, explicitly weak, never replicated or quantified; concerns PI15 and not R3HDML.

claim_tested: The peptidase inhibitor name reflects an inhibitor domain
key_finding: 'The P25TI sequence has no homology to other proteinase inhibitors, but has similarity to insect venom allergens, mammalian testis-specific proteins and plant pathogenesis-related proteins' (the CAP superfamily).
confidence_and_limitations: High for the sequence statement. The naming authors themselves record no inhibitor homology.

claim_tested: The PI15-like clade is a conserved secreted family
key_finding: LGL1 from late gestation lung mesenchyme shares 81% homology with P25TI, placing PI15-like proteins in a vertebrate-conserved secreted clade.
confidence_and_limitations: Moderate. Orientation only; no activity measured.

citation: This work (AlphaFold DB Q9H3Y0 v6; TM-align reimplementation)
claim_tested: R3HDML is a PI15/PI16-type CAP protein, not a CRISP
key_finding: TM-score 0.988 to the PI15 CAP domain (66% structure-based identity); CRISP2/CRISP3 rank last at TM 0.68-0.70. Same signal peptide / propeptide / SCP architecture as PI15.
context: Human AlphaFold model vs 16 CAP structures; positive control GAPR-1 crystal 1SMB vs AF-Q9H4G4 TM=0.966, core RMSD 0.63 A
confidence_and_limitations: High for fold assignment. TM-align was reimplemented locally and validated on a positive control.

citation: This work (AlphaFold Q9H3Y0; 143 vertebrate orthologs from UniProt)
claim_tested: R3HDML retains the canonical CAP His-Glu-Glu-His tetrad
key_finding: The tetrad is His108-Gln119-Glu141-His168: position 2 is glutamine, and is glutamine in 142 of 143 vertebrate orthologs. Site geometry otherwise intact (His1 N to His4 N 5.09 A).
confidence_and_limitations: High for the substitution. Tetrad detection was validated by unsupervised His/Glu clustering recovering four published CAP tetrads.

citation: This work (PDB 1WVR triflin Cd301; superposition transfer)
evidence_type: computational structural, anchored on experimental ion
claim_tested: The degenerate tetrad abolishes the divalent-cation site
key_finding: Refuted. The only cation found at a CAP tetrad in the structure set (triflin Cd301, His60 NE2 2.10 A / His115 NE2 2.11 A) transfers onto R3HDML at 2.70 A from H168 NE2 and 2.92 A from H108 NE2. Tetrad position 2 lies ~8 A from the ion in natrin and GAPR-1 as well, so Gln119 was never a first-shell ligand.
context: Snake venom CRISP crystal structure transferred onto 11 CAP structures
confidence_and_limitations: Moderate. One ion, one crystal structure, Cd as a Zn surrogate; apo AlphaFold rotamers give longer distances (2.7-3.0 A) than the crystal controls (2.1-2.4 A).

citation: This work (Shrake-Rupley SASA; Shannon entropy over 143 orthologs)
claim_tested: The CAP cavity of R3HDML is a maintained functional site
key_finding: The 23 cavity-lining residues have mean ortholog identity 0.925 vs 0.752 elsewhere; median entropy 0.060 vs 0.717 (Mann-Whitney p=4.4e-06). Against a burial-matched null (5000 permutations) the lining is still more conserved: 0.197 vs 0.503, p=0.0004.
confidence_and_limitations: Moderate to high. Orthologs were aligned pairwise to the human sequence rather than by a full MSA, and entropy is therefore slightly conservative.

citation: This work (AlphaFold PAE and contact analysis)
claim_tested: R3HDML has a CRISP-type cysteine-rich / ion-channel-regulatory domain
key_finding: Refuted. The 46-residue, 4-cysteine C-terminal tail scores TM 0.640 against the PI15 tail and only 0.058-0.120 against CRISP CRDs. It packs onto the CAP domain (41% of its heavy atoms within 4.5 A; PAE CAP-to-tail 5.07 A) and N212 lines the CAP cavity.
context: Human AlphaFold model vs CRISP CRDs
confidence_and_limitations: High for the negative. The tail is a PI15-type tail, not a ShKT ion-channel-regulatory module.

citation: This work (cavity volume by probe-accessible grid search)
claim_tested: R3HDML has an enlarged lipid/sterol-binding CAP cavity like Pry1
key_finding: No. The cavity is 78 A3, ordinary for a vertebrate CAP protein and 3.5x smaller than the 275 A3 sterol-binding cavity of Pry1 (5ETE).
confidence_and_limitations: Moderate. Grid-probe volumes are sensitive to probe radius and to apo side-chain placement.

citation: This work (Shrake-Rupley on BPTI 5PTI, OMTKY3 1CSO, eglin c 1ACB)
claim_tested: R3HDML lacks a canonical protease-inhibitor P1 loop
key_finding: Test failed its positive controls: true P1 residues span 11.6-52.8 A2 main-chain SASA and 210-84 protrusion in opposite directions, so no threshold separates inhibitors from non-inhibitors. Reported as uninformative, not as evidence of absence.
context: Three canonical serine-protease inhibitor crystal structures
confidence_and_limitations: The negative control failed; this row carries no evidence about R3HDML.

claim_tested: GO supports a peptidase inhibitor activity annotation for R3HDML
key_finding: It does not. Q9H3Y0 carries only GO:0005576 extracellular region (IBA, IEA) and GO:0060090 molecular adaptor activity (IBA). No GO:0004866 or descendant. Zero experimental molecular function evidence.
context: Database record, retrieved for this report
confidence_and_limitations: High for the annotation state. GO:0060090 is itself an IBA family-level inference, not an R3HDML result.

claim_tested: R3HDML has a described cellular function
key_finding: The two functional papers report downstream phenotypes rather than a molecular activity, so neither constrains the molecular function class.
confidence_and_limitations: Low for molecular function assignment; these are phenotype-level observations.

claim_tested: The PI15/PI16 clade acts through protein-protein binding
key_finding: PI16, the closest characterised relative, carries GO:0005515 protein binding from two interaction studies. No equivalent data exist for R3HDML.
confidence_and_limitations: Moderate for PI16, none for R3HDML. Paralog transfer would be an inference, not evidence.
